lines.en: Hey, listen, can you do me a big favor?
The, uh, Dean's office called and said there's an urgent meeting.
Can you watch Ben for, I don't know, like an hour?
So, it would just be... me alone?
Well, you know, it's just, uh, I've never done that before.
Um, what do I, what do I do with him?
I don't know, just, just talk to him, entertain him, keep him alive.
All right, I'm gonna leave you here with Aunt Rachel for about an hour, okay?
Ben, you know, when, uh, when you were a baby,
you and I used to hang out all the time.
'Cause I was, I was your daddy's girlfriend.
Because you guys were on a break.
Hey, we were not on a break.
So, no, no brothers or sisters, huh?
I had two sisters and we just tortured each other.
Well, you know, we would, um, we'd repeat everything the other said.
Or, uh, we'd jump out of closets to scare each other.
Or, uh, switch the sugar for the salt so they put salt on their cereal.
Well, I got a ton of these.
Um, you, uh, you take a quarter.
And, and you blacken the edge.
And then you say to a person,
"I bet you can't roll this quarter from your forehead to your chin
And then when they do it, they're left with a big black pencil line
right down the center of their face.
Can I do it to you?
I have a bone to pick with you.
Oh, yeah, did he pull the old--
Saran wrap on the toilet seat so the pee goes everywhere.
You know I hate practical jokes.
And, and I don't want my son learning them.
Saran wrap on the toilet seat?
You don't think that's just a little funny?
Well, you know, I was just in the neighborhood
and I passed by your building and I thought to myself,
"What's up with Carol and sweet little Ben?"
Um, I'll, I'll make some coffee and, uh, we can chat.
So, uh, so where is sweet little Ben?
I would love to have a little--
That is exactly why I've come here to talk to you, okay?
Rach, you want some sugar in your coffee?
Yes, but do I want sugar in my coffee?
No, just some milk would be good, Carol. Thanks.
Do you remember all that stuff I taught you yesterday?
Remember all that stuff I taught you yesterday?
Seriously, your dad doesn't like pranks.
Seriously, your dad doesn't like pranks.
No, don't go back to repeating.
Uh, Ben, I can't do it.
Oh, you got something here on your back.
What did we just finish talking about, Ben?
What did we just finish talking about, Ben?
Oh, what did we just finish talking about, Ben?
You know, you are in big trouble, young man.
